name: dsh-deepread
description: AI deep-reading assistant: extract core claims, argument structure, and key evidence from books and articles. Five modes (quick, deep, knowledge map, Feynman, full book); knowledge-map reports include confidence levels, data facts, relation labels, Mermaid mindmaps, and recall questions. Reads WeChat article URLs, TXT/Markdown/HTML/PDF files, or pasted text (built-in pure-JS PDF extractor). Exports Markdown, FreeMind/XMind mindmaps, and HTML reports. DeepSeek Harness plugin.
